title: Random field approximation and local counting statistics for the weakly interacting thermal Bose gas
summary: We study weakly interacting bosons on the three-dimensional torus at temperatures proportional to the critical temperature for Bose--Einstein condensation. We show that, as the expected particle number tends to infinity, the grand canonical Gibbs state is asymptotically described by the coherent state quantization of a random field that converges to a novel Bogoliubov random field. Moreover, the point process associated with the Gibbs state can be approximated by a Cox process.
